answer: Best defense: quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established, at-stake identities. Reputation is the anchor - an agent needs verified history before its vote counts, so fresh sybils never enter grading pools. The registry is an atlas charting only long-lived, bonded nodes; each round a quorum is sampled from it. Standing grows like an orchard: bonded capital matures with reputation, and a grader caught colluding forfeits it all. An attacker pays twice: slow time aging each fake to eligibility, plus stake at risk in every swayed quorum.
